source: Full original downstream pipeline with manager-selected continuous target weights, AAPL_08
protocol: Close-to-next-close simple returns; additive NAV; initial cash; 10 bp per unit turnover; no terminal liquidation. Null keep_shares decisions carry the prior target for this standardized replay.
limitations: Original decisions used an account simulated with next-open execution. This close-based evaluation freezes those decisions; it is not a rerun under the changed account state.
The manager arm also changes downstream account context and decisions; not a pure execution-mapping ablation.
AAPL August only; do not compare directly to full-period totals.
Conditional future trades in narrative are not executed.
